 Mr. Prasanna K. Shahane for the applicant.
 Mr. P.H. Gaikwad, App for the respondent/State.

Coram : Amit Borkar, J.
 Dated : August 19, 2023
 P.C.:
1. Apprehending arrest in connection with C.R. No.487 of 2023 registered with Chakan Police
Station for offences punishable under Sections 420, 465, 467, 471, 406 and 34 of the Indian Penal
Code, 1860, the applicant is seeking relief of pre-arrest bail under Section 438 of the Criminal
Procedure Code, 1973.

2.  According to prosecution, the applicant in furtherance of common intention with other co-accused persons fabricated the false documents and with fraudulent and dishonest intention cheated the complainant and thereby caused wrongful loss to complainant and wrongful gain themselves.
It is alleged that the present applicant at the relevant time played an active role in executing the alleged entire scam.
At the relevant time the applicant was the Director of Rolling Forward Estate Pvt. Ltd.
The 911-aba2022-2023.doc present applicant is directly and indirectly beneficiary in the alleged crime.
Instead of notice to remain present for inquiry before investigating officer, the applicant alleged the not co- operated and remained absent.

sentences.text: There is recovery and discovery at the instance of the present applicant.
3. On perusal of the first information report and case papers, it appears that cheque of Rs.51 lakh is signed by the applicant's husband.
As of now there is no material to indicate active role played by the applicant in the transaction alleged in the first information report.
Therefore, custodial interrogation of the applicant is not necessary.
